step1_analysis.description: A voltage reference circuit intended to use work function differences to generate a stable voltage. In this extracted netlist, all transistors are standard NFETs, the output node (V1) lacks a pull-up path, and XM4 has a forward-biased bulk connection, likely due to extraction errors or missing components.

paper_reference.title: CMOS Voltage Reference Based on Gate Work Function Differences in Poly-Si Controlled by Conductivity Type and Impurity Concentration

Vref.description: DC Reference Voltage at room temperature

sky130_expected.calculation: V1 has no pull-up path to VDD (only connected to XM5 drain and XM1 gate), so it will discharge to 0V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Missing pull-up device in the extracted netlist.

sky130_expected.calculation: Since Vref remains at 0V across temperatures, TC will evaluate to 0.

Line_Regulation.description: Change in Vref with respect to VDD variations

sky130_expected.calculation: Since Vref is stuck at 0V, Line Regulation will be 0.
XM4 has B=VDD and S=GND, forward biasing the P-well to N+ source diode.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Forward biased PN junction from VDD to GND draws massive current, limited only by parasitic resistances.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for measuring Vref, TC, Line Regulation, and Power.
step3_testbench.spice:
* CMOS Voltage Reference Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM5 V1 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM2 N1 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM1 VDD V1 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM4 VDD GND GND VDD sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8

.control
  set temp=27
  op
  let vref_nom = v(V1)
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print vref_nom power

  * Temperature Sweep for TC
  dc temp -40 125 1
  meas dc vref_max max v(V1)
  meas dc vref_min min v(V1)
  meas dc vref_27 find v(V1) at=27
  * Added 1e-9 to avoid division by zero due to missing pull-up
  let tc_ppm = (vref_max - vref_min) / ((vref_27 + 1e-9) * 165) * 1e6
  print tc_ppm

  * VDD Sweep for Line Regulation
  dc VVDD 1.2 1.8 0.01
  meas dc vref_vdd_18 find v(V1) at=1.8
  meas dc vref_vdd_12 find v(V1) at=1.2
  let line_reg = (vref_vdd_18 - vref_vdd_12) / 0.6
  print line_reg
  
  quit
.endc
.end
